content.contents: i've been having a stupidly hard time recently
i don't want to treat this blog like a public journal, but sometimes i want to vent, and i know not many read these posts so i think i'm more than welcome to say my piece
that's the point in a blog, right? to have your own place to put your own stuff. that's what i wanted it for anyway
let me get into what i was talking about
last year, as i've mentioned in previous blogs, i was diagnosed with ADHD and C-PTSD, and i'm working at the moment on processing what that means and how it contextualizes my life

it contextualized my life in a big way, actually, and it's something that scares the shit out of me, because i'm starting to understand just how much this has been a contributor to my low self-esteem pretty much since i was a child.
everybody tells you to be yourself, and that if you're yourself people will love you, true love will find you in the end
but i've always found because i'm kind of, without sounding too reddit, different or weird, that i have to pretend i'm someone or something i'm not because if i don't, well
it's always been 'you're really annoying' or 'you're a retard' or the silent treatment, being ignored until you go someplace else to annoy some other people
that's just what life is, and it makes it even harder when you try to work in a creative 'industry'

it's why i love Aphex Twin so much, or Elliott Smith, both neurodiverse to some degree. it's been confirmed Elliott had ADHD, RDJ has eluded to having autism, it's just nice that there's actually people out there who have lived your dreams and have probably had some of the same struggles as you

but they're popular and they're influential and they're revered for it because they're popular and influential, so what happens to the regular people who want to become artists and have these kinds of issues?
i try to talk to others and i worry constantly about everything i say because i don't want to live up to the 'dumbass' standard that i feel everybody holds towards me
i'm trying to work more on being confident in myself but there's another aspect apart from ADHD that come into play, and that's the fact that i'm trans

and i battled with myself about that for a really, really long time. i didn't want to disappoint anyone and i was already so fuckin scared all the time of people that i kept that side of me tucked away (no pun intended) for years, but i knew.

i knew as early as 14 years old, i knew what i wanted to be, i knew how miserable i was, going through a puberty that made me grow more and more into this disgusting monster with the passing of each day

so finally in 2020 i couldn't do it anymore and i came out and i've been out since. and i've been trying to find the strength to grant myself the love i need to live while being stared at every day if i dare to step foot outside of my house, and i see vitriol every day online from people who've never lived a day outside of the capitalist gold standard of straight and white and secure in everything. people who claim we're all groomers or pedophiles when they won't even stop to consider how many of us are the victims of these accusations they paint so carelessly
you're told your whole life to be yourself, to just be yourself and love yourself and be true to who you are and if you do, people will love you, true love will find you in the end
but how can i believe that's the truth when i see my people suffer every day?
how can i believe that's the truth when we make international headlines on a weekly basis because our mere existence is such a hot topic of political debate?

we are but a bargaining chip in the face of the omnipresent political hierarchy. our right to exist is deliberated over by a council of people who have, at most, 2 gay friends, and have probably never met a single one of us in their entire lives

they deliberate over 'what-ifs' and 'what-abouts' proposed by people who have no idea who we are or what we do or what we're like, they deliberate over statistics that have been gathered by parties who are not only biased against our existence but are paid to 'research' us by the ones who deliberate

do you know how hard it is to live life as an inconvenience? for some, i'm sure you do, but we are not the majority here. that's why people like SOPHIE or Arca or Ethel Cain mean so much. they exist in the face of a world order that seeks to eradicate our existence piece by piece. these people seek to make our living conditions so vile that we either forcibly detransition or kill ourselves, because ultimately, we are an inconvenience to their system
and i nearly did not long ago. i nearly gave in to their pleas, when a certain supreme court mandate came out
i was told by the crisis worker with which i spoke, avoid the news, don't read anything about it because it'll just cause you to spiral again
and i went to the store the day after and every single newspaper there had a headline speaking of the great 'victory' for women that had come out of the supreme court the day before

what a painful insult, to be told that the verification of your government invalidating your entire existence is a 'victory', a massive 'victory' against a historically and presently oppressed minority
it's not a victory for all women, mind you
it's just a victory for women who have fallen for the fearmongering perpetuated by the powers that be
and meanwhile there's a group of women who are stuck here, being kicked and spat on and beaten repeatedly while the whole world claps in the name of 'feminism'
bioessentialist feminism, which mind you has had its fundamentals challenged and has been widely critiqued for decades now
if you're not careful, you may end up rooting for the oppressor

all these 'feminists' who were biting their nails over this 'revolutionary' court case, have found themselves in this position, rooting for a government that seeks to destroy what we love in the name of power

and that day in comment sections i saw 'lesbians', 'feminists' and the ever-present cis white men sneering and spitting on trans people, claiming the 'victory' was a necessity in the name of protecting 'womens rights' (while stripping away any rights this one group of other'd women we hate have), claiming 'they've finally let some grownups into the courts', claiming we cannot compare trans rights being taken away with what's going on in the states or hungary or the rest of europe lurching to the right because this is 'common sense'.

you know, at one point in history the industrialized mass-murder of our people seemed to be 'common sense' as well, to a particular group, and we were each and every one of us marked with a pink triangle
and while the average united states citizen is currently debating over the definition of a concentration camp, the people in power are debating over who to send there next
seems they're going to start with 'home-grown' criminals
i wonder how they're going to define a criminal?
i wonder if this government that makes sweeping changes to legislation with the passing of each day and holds high disdain for trans people would ever... y'know.
and more and more i see people my age praising nazis, contemporaries in this scene sampling nazis and thinking they're so cool for it, cool for sampling speeches from people who industrialized mass murder
they'll use whatever excuse, 'the holocaust didn't really happen', 'the numbers were greatly exaggerated', all of the typical dogwhistles they've been trained to bleet out whenever they can to justify their cause
some don't even excuse it, they just don't care, or they think what happened was a good thing
but they still claim to support trans people and gay people
well, it's not really support. it's moreso not actively berating them in public spaces and instead insulting them by sharing memes that depict us as evil subhuman creatures that want to assault women and children or making crude, disgusting jokes with their friends because it's an easy way to become reputable in a group of white men
as i said just before,
if you're not careful, you may end up rooting for the oppressor
it's a very easy mistake to make to those who live their lives in ignorant bliss

i can't anymore listen to those who insist on 'staying out of politics', either.
not all of us were born with such a privilege. some of us have our existence on this planet politicized to no end, with no consent.
i'd like you all to read this poem, by Catholic Pastor, Martin Niemöller.

'First they came for the Communists
And I did not speak out
Because I was not a Communist
Then they came for the Socialists
And I did not speak out
Because I was not a Socialist
Then they came for the trade unionists
And I did not speak out
Because I was not a trade unionist
Then they came for the Jews
And I did not speak out
Because I was not a Jew
Then they came for me
And there was no one left
To speak out for me'

i ask you, who drift through this life meeting no criticism, no backlash, no political resistance
when will you cry mea culpa?
you who are complacent, you who stand for nothing
you who live and breathe this middle, this ease, this whole into which you've slipped, without a worry or care, you who can breeze through life
when will you cry mea culpa?

in the face of all of this, and including the rest of the bullshit i've faced in my life, i really, really struggle to find ways to love myself, and to keep going
and i know that's precisely how i'm meant to feel right now
but i keep fighting, because i have a dream of being a professional musician, and i have a dream of writing albums people will love, and i want to keep that going, hard as it may be

and i keep fighting because i have a wonderful girlfriend who has supported me at every corner, and who's helping me to unpack every aspect of this seemingly insurmountable challenge that's in front of me and every other trans human who's beside me right now
i love you all. i want to fight all of this with you. trans people have always, and will always exist. nothing will ever change that, because it is a matter of fact.
try to have a good day, please

one last thing. if you need someone to talk to my line is always open. you can email me @ static.grl.digital@gmail.com (or if you don't like email you can add me on discord, too. my name on there is just static.grl)

if you can, please keep fighting.
